title: The duality pairing and the double-dual morphism
statement:
Let $X$ be a separated finite-type scheme over a field, with finite
coefficients invertible on that field. On the ambient etale derived
category put $\omega_X=Ra_X^{\times}A$, using the right adjoint of
[thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and let
$D_X=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_X)$. For every complex $K$, the
evaluation of internal Hom is a natural pairing

$$
\mathrm{ev}_K:D_XK\otimes_A^LK\longrightarrow\omega_X.
$$

Its transpose is the natural double-dual morphism
$\delta_K:K\to D_XD_XK$. It is compatible with shifts and is a
morphism of distinguished triangles. The same formal construction
applies on the pro-etale site whenever its ambient dualizing object is
specified; it does not assume that $D_XK$ is constructible.

proof.text: Use the source-library parametrized tensor-Hom adjunction on each ambient derived category. Present its tensor as the raw localized tensor using etaleTensorRaw (etale) and the abstract nativeTensorRaw identity (pro-etale). The raw derived braiding gives a natural isomorphism b whose components are exactly the specified Koszul braiding. No new tensor descent or chain currying is required.

In an arbitrary braided monoidal category with a parametrized tensor-Hom adjunction a, put D(K)=H(K,W), ev_K=a_K^(-1)(id_DK), and e_K=beta_(K,DK)^(-1) followed by ev_K. Then a_K(beta_(K,DK) e_K)=id. Parametrized homEquiv naturality in the first and second variables and braiding naturality prove dinaturality of e. Build the self-adjunction D.rightOp ⊣ D using the reverse braiding: its hom bijection uncarries, interchanges factors, and curries. Its unit is exactly delta_K=a_DK(e_K), so unit naturality proves naturality of delta.

Apply coherent contravariant exactness [lem-weil-native-internal-hom-contravariant-exact] to native Hom(-,W). Uniqueness of right adjoints gives its natural isomorphism with H(-,W); the parametrized counit identity proves naturality in the source. Transport shifts and exactness along this proved isomorphism to D. Give the left adjoint D.rightOp the shift structure adjoint to that of D. Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint makes it exact. Their composite D² is exact; Mathlib NatTrans.shift_app_comm for the unit proves the required integral shift identity. For each distinguished triangle build the morphism with components delta. Its first two squares are unit naturality. The third is naturality on the connecting arrow followed by the shift identity at 1.

Specialize to the small etale sheaf category and the stated dualizing object, and to the pro-etale sheaf category with arbitrary W. Pass the recorded localization instances explicitly, so checking the proof does not expand the monoidal closed construction. This proves both clauses without reconstructing the already specified ambient dualizing object. The standalone etaleKoszulSymmetry proof is retained verbatim.
